n76512c89d1.headline: Algeria renovates drilling, storage and water distribution facilities
n76512c89d1.summary: Algeria's Ministry of Water Resources announced mobilizing more than six billion dinars through the National Water Fund to renovate drilling, storage, and water distribution facilities.
n76512c89d1.why: Infrastructure investments in water resources are critical for Algeria's economic development and resource management.

nfe4c2097c1.headline: The company HPS opens an office in Singapore
nfe4c2097c1.summary: Hightech Payment Systems (HPS), a Moroccan electronic payment solutions leader, has opened a new office in Singapore to strengthen client proximity in the Asian market.
nfe4c2097c1.why: HPS's expansion into Asia reflects growing fintech demand and cross-border business development in electronic payments.
